## Highlights

- Substantially expands deterministic recovery of headings, paragraphs,
  emphasis, lists, code blocks, tables, links, figures, footnotes, columns, and
  reading order.
- Makes hybrid evidence byte-bounded, provenance-preserving, and subordinate to
  stronger deterministic evidence.
- Hardens Carve serialization for block openers, URLs, IDs, captions, table
  alignment, and canonical validation.
- Adds a generated regression corpus, comparison artifacts, and a repeatable
  100-page performance profile.
- Updates development and conformance checks to released `carve-lang` 0.1.2 and
  corrects the exported package version to 0.1.2.

The deterministic conversion path remains local and uses no AI or network
service.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/markup-carve/pdf-to-carve/compare/v0.1.1...v0.1.2
